[[Lucent Mote]]s are [[crafting material]]s acquired by [[salvaging]] certain [[upgrade component]]s and [[equipment]] containing them. Their only use is to be refined; effectively allowing [[Pile of Lucent Crystal|Piles of Lucent Crystals]] to be acquired in tenths.

== Acquisition ==
{{see|Pile of Lucent Crystal#Acquisition}}

=== Salvaged from ===
* Any Minor, Major or Superior [[rune]].
* Any Minor, Major or Superior [[sigil]].
* Any [[relic]].
* Any equipment with embedded runes or sigils, when not using a [[salvage kit]] which recovers upgrades (like [[Black Lion Salvage Kit]]).
* [[Unidentified Gear]]:
** {{item icon|Piece of Common Unidentified Gear}}
** {{item icon|Piece of Unidentified Gear}}
** {{item icon|Piece of Rare Unidentified Gear}}
** ''Note:'' It is highly recommended to identify before salvaging, both because the gear can upgrade in rarity, and the salvage rates are significantly higher afterwards.

== Used in ==
{{recipe list}}

== Notes ==
* Higher rarity items have a greater salvage rate.
* Salvage research for runes, sigils and relics can be found on their respective pages:
** [[Rune/salvage research]]
** [[Sigil/salvage research]]
** [[Relic/salvage research]]
* Salvage rates from [[unidentified gear]] can be found on their respective pages:
** [[Piece of Common Unidentified Gear/Salvage Rate]]
** [[Piece of Unidentified Gear/Salvage Rate]]
** [[Piece of Rare Unidentified Gear/Salvage Rate]]
